description: We are Newtonians, a team of high school STEM students with a shared interest in science, technology, and space exploration. Our team brings together artists, storytellers, writers, visionaries, and developers, each contributing unique skills and ideas. As novices in the world of hackathons, we are eager to learn, explore new ideas, and challenge ourselves. As a team, we work together to explore ideas, develop our skills, and find meaningful ways to share our love for science with others.
summary:
Martian Time Capsule: Mission to Discover Mars' Forgotten Equipment is an interactive educational game designed to teach children and space enthusiasts about the equipment, machinery, and spacecraft components left behind on Mars during past exploration missions.

Through fun exploration challenges, players can discover abandoned equipment, learn its purpose, and understand its role in space exploration. The project addresses the challenge of making scientific information more accessible, interesting, and engaging, especially for younger audiences.

By combining education with interactive gameplay, Martian Time Capsule transforms learning about space debris and Mars exploration history into an exciting discovery experience. It also raises awareness about the lasting presence of human-made objects on other planets and encourages curiosity about responsible space exploration.
details:
The Martian Time Capsule is designed for children and space enthusiasts. For children, we believe that curiosity and a love for learning should be nurtured at an early age. As Whitney Houston sang in her song, " The Greatest Love of All, " “I believe the children are our future; teach them well and let them lead the way”. Through our interactive space treasure hunt, children will roleplay as astronauts sent on a mission to Mars. We aim to ignite children’s curiosity by introducing them to the terrific Rovers and Landers that have explored Mars, including Sojourner, Spirit & Opportunity, Viking 1 & 2, Phoenix, and InSight. By discovering these treasures and learning about their missions, children can explore the wonders of the Red Planet and understand there is much more to discover beyond Earth. 

For Space Enthusiasts, we believe that learning is a lifelong process. No matter how much we learn about space, there will always be something new and wonderful to discover. Through the Martian Time Capsule,  we hope to deepen their understanding of Mars by revisiting the remarkable missions of the Rovers and Landers that explored the Red Planet and helped scientists uncover its mysteries. By uncovering the stories behind these space treasures,  we aim to remind them that every discovery opens the door to new questions, knowledge, and possibilities. 

Ultimately, the Martian Time Capsule aims to strengthen appreciation for space exploration and inspire them to continue seeking knowledge about the universe. More importantly, we hope to inspire younger generations and future space explorers to keep exploring, stay curious, and never stop dreaming BIG!

The Martian Time Capsule is developed in a game format using GDevelop, a platform for creating interactive games. By making the game accessible through a website, players can conveniently experience the adventure using a compatible device with internet access, without needing to install a separate application. This format also allows players to actively participate in the learning experience rather than simply read or listen to information. Furthermore, the game's graphics and visual elements are digitally hand-drawn to create a colorful, engaging, and child-friendly environment, particularly for children aged five and above. Through its interactive gameplay, simple visuals, and storytelling, The Martian Time Capsule aims to make learning about Mars both accessible and enjoyable for children and space enthusiasts.

We want to focus on celebrating humanity's achievements in interplanetary exploration through the remarkable missions and spacecraft that have traveled to Mars. Rather than telling a broad history of NASA's space exploration, The Martian Time Capsule highlights specific rovers and landers, such as Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Viking 1 and 2, Phoenix, and InSight. Each of these missions represents a significant step in our efforts to understand another planet. Through their discoveries, we aim to showcase human curiosity, innovation, perseverance, and the remarkable things humanity can achieve when we dare to explore beyond our own planet.

 Our game, called the Martian Time Capsule, centers on the exciting adventure of an Astronaut sent on a two-day mission to uncover the treasures left behind on Mars, such as the rovers and landers that once explored the Red planet. Just like a Time Capsule that preserves meaningful objects and stories from the past, these space exploration artifacts hold valuable discoveries, achievements, and knowledge that help us understand Mars today. 

Through the astronaut's journey, we want to highlight the perspectives of discovery, exploration, and companionship. The astronaut represents the curiosity and eagerness to learn about the unknown,  while the alien companion symbolizes how discovering new things becomes more exciting and meaningful when shared with someone who has the same curiosity and enthusiasm. Together, they show that learning does not have to be a solitary experience; it can be an enjoyable adventure built on shared discoveries, questions, and wonder. 

Ultimately, we want to emphasize that space exploration is not only about reaching distant places but also about the joy of discovery, the value of companionship, and the continuous pursuit of knowledge.
